name: Gideon Carter
role: Early elder killed at Crooked River
dateNote: He was baptized on 25 October 1831 and killed at Crooked River, Missouri, on 25 October 1838.
importance: He was ordained an elder at the Amherst conference, and section 75 pairs him there with Sylvester Smith for a mission. He later served on the Kirtland high council. He moved to Far West in 1838 and was killed at the Crooked River skirmish.
connections: His companion in section 75 was Sylvester Smith. David W. Patten was also mortally wounded at Crooked River.

sources.title: Gideon Hayden Carter, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 1798, Killingworth, Connecticut; baptized by Joseph Smith 25 Oct. 1831 at Orange; ordained elder 25 Jan. 1832 at Amherst; Kirtland high council 1837; Far West 1838; killed at Crooked River (date shown as a fragment, 25 Oct. 1838).
